item.title: Xbox Studio On Brink of Closure Gets More Time To Find a Home and Finish Marvel's Blade
item.description: The last few months at Xbox Studios have been a bloodbath. Microsoft announced in July that it would be cutting 3,200 jobs from its Xbox division in the coming year and has since made over 1,800 cuts. As part of those layoffs, Xbox also announced it would cut several beloved game studios. While Double Fine, Compulsion Games, and Undead Labs managed to buy back their independence from Xbox, it seems that Hellblade developer Ninja Theory will be shutting down .

item.title: 'Public Access Afterworld' Is a Brilliant Mess That 'Camp Miasma' Fans Need to Read ASAP
item.description: As a follower of Schoenbrun’s work, I can’t help but know so much about them. I know that they used to work as a film critic before directing and writing movies. I know that they’re trans, and that their work is in constant conversation with that identity. It has propelled them to become one of the most notable voices in indie cinema.

item.title: Pokémon Pokopia DLC 2 Leaks Reveal New Pokémon and More
item.description: Pokémon Pokopia offers new ways for players to interact with their favorite Pocket Monsters. Instead of capturing and battling Pokémon , players talk with them and build them homes. It's an early Nintendo Switch 2 hit, and, unsurprisingly, Pokémon Pokopia received a new DLC expansion over the summer. More DLC is on the way in 2026, and new leaks hint at what's to come.

item.title: FBI Is Officially Investigating An Unprecedented Pokémon Card Heist
item.description: Earlier in October, authorities revealed that a FedEx truck reportedly containing nearly $1 million in cards graded by the Professional Sports Authenticator had suddenly gone missing. A couple of weeks later, the apparent theft of 6,451 slabs — many of which contained Pokémon cards — is being scrutinized by the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

item.title: Square Enix Reveals Stunning New Final Fantasy 40th Anniversary Release
item.description: Since the series' inception in 1987, music has always been an integral part of Final Fantasy . Across sixteen mainline entries and countless spin-offs, the iconic RPG franchise has used music to amplify emotional moments and stories. As part of ongoing 40th anniversary celebrations, Square Enix has announced a series-spanning soundtrack that already looks like a must-buy.

item.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Hackers Made a Huge Breakthrough
item.description: With recent advances in generative AI, video game hacking and piracy are advancing faster than ever, much to the chagrin of the game industry. As Sony scrambles to release new firmware updates in response to PS5 jailbreaking efforts , Nintendo hackers are finding similar success.

item.title: Fortnite Reveals First Look at One Piece Content
item.description: For weeks, there have been rumors that One Piece would be the centerpiece of the next Fortnite season. There was no certainty, so fans were on the edge of their seats until the last second. It wasn't until this Sunday that Epic Games put them out of their misery and unveiled the One Piece crossover season. More teasers are starting to surface, giving players a first look at the One Piece skins coming to Fortnite .

item.title: Street Fighter Star Reveals Disappointment with Movie’s Ending
item.description: Street Fighter was released in theaters this October, and, unlike Capcom's other video game movie released this year, Resident Evil , it was not a bona fide hit. Street Fighter is messy and, at times, incoherent. However, it is a good time at the movies if all you want to see is beautiful people smack each other around while '90s hits play.

item.title: Marvel Casts 'Game of Thrones' Star for New 'X-Men' Movie, Report Says
item.description: While Avengers: Doomsday is the MCU’s next big event, many fans are already looking ahead to Marvel’s upcoming X-Men reboot. According to a report from Knight Edge Media , Peter Claffey has been cast as Beast in the 2028 X-Men film . Claffey is an Irish actor best known for his recent portrayal of Sir Duncan in HBO’s acclaimed A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms .
